doc: Wake-word front-end (high-pass, gate, AGC) parameter sets. ONE source of truth: Rust (src/wake_dsp.rs, compiled in with include_str!) and scripts/train_local_wakeword.py both read this file. 'legacy' reproduces the runtime as shipped before B7 (uses the per-device acoustic_profile for gate, high-pass and a minimum gain). 'aligned' is exactly what the trainer feeds the classifier, so serving matches training. Switch with the wakeDspProfile setting; compare with wake_eval --dsp.

legacy.comment: highpass_hz, silence_rms and floor_gain come from the AcousticProfile (cutoff, silence_rms_threshold, pre_gain)
